import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify potential drivers among clinical features
    clinical_ids = [fid for fid, t in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if t == 'clinical']
    if not clinical_ids:
        # No clinical features, try to find drivers among all features
        candidates = [(fid, i) for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids)]
    else:
        # Use clinical features as potential drivers
        candidates = [(fid, i) for fid in clinical_ids for i in [feats.column(fid)]]
    
    # Check if any clinical feature shows strong association with outcome
    best_clinical = None
    max_effect = 0
    
    for fid, col_idx in candidates:
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        effect_size = np.mean(x[y==1]) - np.mean(x[y==0])
        if abs(effect_size) > max_effect:
            max_effect = abs(effect_size)
            best_clinical = fid
    
    # If no strong clinical driver found, return empty design
    if not best_clinical or max_effect < 0.1:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select features significantly associated with outcome (p < 0.05)
    significant_features = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        
        # Welch's t-test
        group0 = x[y==0]
        group1 = x[y==1]
        if len(group0) > 1 and len(group1) > 1:
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1, equal_var=False)
            if p_val < 0.05:
                significant_features.append((fid, col_idx))
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep_features = set()
    for fid1, col1 in significant_features:
        keep = True
        for fid2 in keep_features:
            if fid1 == fid2:
                continue
            col2 = feats.column(fid2)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                keep = False
                break
        if keep:
            keep_features.add(fid1)
    
    # Build regression components
    columns = tuple(keep_features)
    drivers = (best_clinical,) if best_clinical in columns else ()
    
    # Compute loadings (weighted sum of features)
    loadings = {}
    if columns:
        # Simple weighted combination using effect sizes
        for fid in columns:
            col_idx = feats.column(fid)
            x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
            effect = np.mean(x[feats.y==1]) - np.mean(x[feats.y==0])
            loadings[fid] = effect
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=columns,
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
